retrievalProfile.description: A dark purple canvas featuring a complex, neon-green line-art figure with a central red accent, framed by a stylized bone-pattern border.
triggerTerms: neon green line art on dark purple
excludeWhen: corporate clean vector styles are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, complex humanoid figure composed of continuous neon-green outlines against a deep indigo-purple background. The figure features a sun-like radiating head, multiple eyes, and a rib-like structure containing a solid red, spiked heart. The entire composition is enclosed in a rectangular border made of repeating bone-shaped icons.
coreVisualRelationships: Neon green outlines contrasting against deep purple background
Solid red heart as the singular high-contrast focal point
Repeating bone icons forming a structural frame
Vertical symmetry in the central figure's placement
coreInvariants: Continuous neon-green line weight for the main subject
Deep indigo or dark purple solid background
Stylized bone-motif border framing the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The abstract figure is centered, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid red, spiked heart located in the lower-center of the figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the radiating head, move down the central axis to the red heart, then circulate through the intricate rib-like line work.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark purple space between the figure and the border to allow the neon lines to glow.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for the green and red against a low-value, dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Top-left text uses a classic, high-contrast serif
Right-side text uses a wide-tracked, lowercase sans-serif
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a traditional serif and a modern, spaced-out sans-serif.

preserve: Vertical orientation of the right-side text
Pale yellow color for all text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif look for the top-left text.
Matches the clean, open feel for the vertical sans-serif text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a deep purple background with a neon-green line-art surrealist figure in the center, featuring a red spiked heart and a bone-pattern border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add pale yellow serif text in the top-left and vertically stacked, wide-tracked lowercase sans-serif text along the right edge.

verificationChecks: Is the background a dark indigo/purple?
Is the central figure drawn in neon-green outlines?
Is there a single red heart focal point?
Is the bone border present and consistent?

mustRedesign: Do not replicate specific artist signatures
Ensure the figure is an original surrealist abstraction

avoid: Cluttered typography that overlaps the main figure

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red heart is the only red element.
Verify the bone border is a continuous frame.
Ensure the neon green lines have a consistent 'glow' effect.
Confirm the vertical text on the right is legible despite the tracking.
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist Line Art + Neon-on-Dark Palette + Thematic Border Frame
